decisions.reason: Although its website prominence fell from a dedicated page to a mention, it remained in the assortment through 2024 and as a close-to-core upholstery fabric it likely performs near a satisfactory aspiration level while still supporting portfolio breadth.

Its continued mention across 2023 and 2024 suggests acceptable market reception, and for a medium-sized textile firm with some innovative slack a decorative fabric close to the core offer would be retained if it is at least satisfactory.

Being presented on its own page in both years indicates comparatively strong attention and likely performance above aspiration, especially for a functional flame-retardant curtain fabric aligned with contract-textile demand.

It stayed on the website over two years and builds on the established collection, so management would likely view it as satisfactorily contributing to the broad range rather than reallocating resources away from it.

As a continued part of the website and an extension of the firm’s known decorative-textile capabilities, it likely clears a modest aspiration threshold and is worth keeping while the firm maintains assortment variety.

Because it was newly launched in 2024 with a page of its own, the product is still in an early uncertainty phase and a firm with some organisational slack would normally give it more time before judging it below aspiration.
